summary: Procedural noise texture generator with Perlin, Simplex, Sparse, Random, Alligator, and harmonic-style noise controls. It can sample transformed 2D/3D/4D noise space, combine noise with an input texture, accept a coordinate-map input, and output alpha or gradient information for masks, displacement, feedback, and shader inputs.

key_params.name: type
key_params.note: Noise function such as Perlin, Simplex, Random GPU, Sparse, Hermite, Harmonic Summation, Random, or Alligator.

key_params.name: seed
key_params.note: Random seed that changes the generated pattern.

key_params.name: period
key_params.note: Approximate spatial period of the noise; inverse of frequency.

key_params.name: harmon
key_params.note: Number of harmonics/layers in the noise.

key_params.name: exp
key_params.note: Exponent applied to the generated noise.

key_params.name: mono
key_params.note: Generate monochrome noise rather than separate channel noise.

key_params.name: xord
key_params.note: Transform order for sampling plane transforms.

key_params.name: rord
key_params.note: Rotate order for sampling plane transforms.

key_params.name: t
key_params.note: Translate the sampling plane through noise space.

key_params.name: r
key_params.note: Rotate the sampling plane in noise space.

key_params.name: t4d
key_params.note: Translate the fourth coordinate for 4D noise.

key_params.name: s4d
key_params.note: Scale the fourth coordinate for 4D noise.

key_params.name: rgb
key_params.note: Output or combine input and noise as noise-only, multiply, add, or subtract.

key_params.name: inputscale
key_params.note: Amount of input image added to the output.

key_params.name: noisescale
key_params.note: Amount of noise added to the output.

key_params.name: alpha
key_params.note: Alpha output source such as zero, one, noise, input, or input/noise combinations.

key_params.name: dither
key_params.note: Dither output to reduce 8-bit banding artifacts.

key_params.name: gradient
key_params.note: Output gradient/slope of supported noise functions.

common_gotchas: Period is the opposite of frequency: larger Period values make broader, slower-changing noise features.
The second input is a Noise Coordinate Map; its RGBA channels provide 2D, 3D, or 4D lookup coordinates rather than a normal image layer.
For 3D Texture output, use a 3D texture input from Texture 3D TOP or GLSL TOP so the output can inherit the needed texture type and depth.
Gradient output is currently supported for Performance mode Simplex and Perlin noise types, and it is the derivative of the noise function, not image-space derivatives.
Quality mode reduces certain Simplex artifacts and axis alignment issues at a speed cost.
The Transform page t parameter moves the sampling plane in noise space; use it intentionally for animation rather than treating it as a generic time parameter.
